notes.title: New update for Save the Dodos!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Save the Dodos has been out for some weeks and in the meantime loads of Dodos have been saved from their horrible demise. Our feathery friends are forever in your debt. We’ve also just released an update with some fixes and features. Check the list below for a comprehensive overview

Windowed Mode has been added, now you can save the Dodos while doing other stuff on your computer!
Steam Achievements have been added to the game! You can collect 43 achievements.
Hungrarian localisation has been added
Some of you were experiencing a ‘Direct X problem’. That problem has been fixed
 Users of Avast Virus protection we’re experiencing problems, that problem has also been fixed.
 
Thanks for all your feedback so far and keep it coming!
